notes: All features are signed in price direction and known at the completed bar endpoint.
R is the bar return over trailing 24h volatility; P = s * pb_activity prediction; X = R - P is the signed residual.
q is the linear signed imbalance over trailing 24h volume, a naive flow benchmark for P.
pre15 and pre60 are clock-time returns ending at the bar start, over trailing volatility.
P uses the frozen rolling impact fit calibrated strictly before each month.
Forecast regressions are fitted on the preceding 12 months only and frozen for the test month.
Delayed targets enter at the first 200-event endpoint at least entry_delay_ms after the decision.
Costs are base-tier Binance USDT-M assumptions and should be replaced with the actual tier.
